rooms.name: Dark Cell
rooms.description: Big bars block your way, weirdly there is no lock. You hear an old man humming a melody.

items.name: Nail
items.message: You tap the bars mimicking the old man's melody. The cell door swings open.

npcs.name: Old Man
dialogue:
... *hums a melody* ... la la la la laaaa...
Hmm? Hello!
*hums again* la la la la laaaa... The bars... the bars don't like music you know... *taps the wall rhythmically*
The lord of this castle locked me here years ago... he fears the sword in the treasury...
The treasury is beyond the great hall... *hums louder* ...la la la la laaaa...

rooms.name: Prison Corridor
rooms.description: A long hallway lined with empty cells. Torches flicker on the walls. At the far end, a guard dozes in his chair beside a heavy door. A key hangs loosely from his belt.

items.name: Key
items.description: A heavy iron key from the sleeping guard's belt
items.message: You quietly slip the key into the lock. The door clicks open without a sound.

rooms.name: Castle Courtyard
rooms.description: Fresh air at last. The castle courtyard is cold and grey. A well sits in the center. The great hall is to the north. Mud and old blood stain the cobblestones.

npcs.name: Slave
dialogue:
Psst! You there! How did you get out?
There is a sword in the treasury beneath the great hall. They say it was forged to slay the lord himself. That is why he hid it.
Go. Before someone sees us talking.

rooms.name: Great Hall
rooms.description: A vast hall with a long feasting table covered in food. Banners bearing the lord's crest hang from the ceiling. A staircase leads up to the lord's chambers to the north. A passage to the east leads to the treasury.

items.name: Torch
items.description: A lit torch from the wall bracket, useful in dark places

rooms.name: Treasury
rooms.description: A dark stone room. Dusty chests line the walls, most empty. In the center, mounted on a stone pedestal, is a sword radiating a faint glow.

condition.darkDescription: It is pitch black. You can't see anything. You need a light source.

items.name: Sword
items.description: A magnificent blade etched with ancient runes. It feels alive.
items.message:
You raise the ancient sword. The runes glow bright.
The Lord stumbles back... and falls.

The castle falls silent.
You have slain the lord. The prisoners are free.

YOU WIN

rooms.name: Lord's Chambers
rooms.description: A lavish room reeking of wine and arrogance. The lord sits by the fire, his back to you. He turns slowly and rises, drawing his blade.

condition.failMessage:
You burst into the lord's chambers empty handed. He takes one look at you and laughs.
He draws his blade and cuts you down before you can blink.

You are dead.

GAME OVER

npcs.name: Lord
dialogue:
Who dares enter my chambers? A prisoner? *laughs coldly* You should have stayed in your cell.
That sword... where did you find that sword... *steps back* It cannot be...
GUARDS! GUARDS! *draws his blade* I will deal with you myself, wretch.
